context.objective: Document how we carry out AEA Due to Managers Workbook Procedure, the controls and what needs confirmation.

turns.text: To begin with, we confirm the trigger and complete fund list. That is done by: GPFS preparer. Next, we set up the quarterly workbook. That is done by: GPFS preparer.
What event or input prompts the preparer to confirm the trigger and complete fund list?
After that, we import Bilixio expenses and cash receipts. That is done by: GPFS preparer. Then, we update pivot tables and formulas. That is done by: GPFS preparer; reviewer.
What do the updated pivot tables and formulas calculate in the AEA Due to Managers workbook?
Once that is done, we complete the summary/invoice tab. That is done by: GPFS preparer. Following that, we reconcile every project code to Sage. That is done by: GPFS preparer; reviewer.
What do the pivot tables and formulas calculate?
